title: Amazing Athletic Portuguese Flaxseed Bowl
description: A post-workout Portuguese dish featuring fermented flaxseed, this bowl is designed to help athletes recover with a low-glycemic friendly meal.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the ground flaxseed and lemon juice to create a flaxseed gel.
Let the flaxseed gel sit for 5 minutes to thicken.
In a blender, combine the plain yogurt, honey, olive oil, salt, and portuguese sea salt, and blend until smooth.
Add the flaxseed gel to the blender and blend until well combined.
Stir in the chia seeds and shredded coconut.
Pour the mixture into a bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the bowl chilled, garnished with additional shredded coconut if desired.
Emulsify the mixture by stirring it vigorously before serving.
